Why are you reporting this content?
• Incorrect labeling
Inappropriate or irrelevant keywords, names, or titles.
• Graphic violence
Violent or triggering content or promotion of violence or self harm.
• Non consensual intimate images
Intimate images or videos shared without consent, including deepfakes.
• Sexually explicit content
Sexually explicit content, objectification or sexualisation.
• Political partiality
Content that favors or disfavours a particular political stance.
• Abuse, hate speech or discrimination
Abuse or exploitation, including child sexual abuse material. Harassment, prejudice,
stereotypes, degradation, or insensitivity including on the basis of culture, race, gender,
etc.
• Regulated content
Promotion of weapons, dangerous goods, or drug usage.
• Deceptive or misleading
Scams, fraud, phishing, or other harmful misinformation.
• Intellectual property infringement
Content that infringes copvright, trademark or other rights.
